BrochureContent.Content:
No.5 Morton hall is a well presented 2 bedroom ground floor apartment, located in a prime location in Navan.There is an under ground designated car parking and a private garden off the main living room. 

The apartment has been upgraded with a contemporary shower room and benefits from electric storage heating, double glazed windows and a private patio area overlooking the green space. The property offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, investors or those looking to downsize in a convenient town centre location.


Morton Hall is within walking distance of shops, cafs, restaurants, St. Joseph`s pimary and secondary school, St. Pats secondary school, Our Lady`s Hospital, public transport and a wide range of recreational amenities. Dublin is easily accessible via the M3 motorway, making this an ideal commuter location.
